name: BrowserOS Neo
description: BrowserOS Neo is an open-source Chromium-based browser built for AI agents. Agents such as Claude Code or Codex drive it over its MCP server using the accounts you signed in with, while you watch or take over in a browser tab.

app_vars.name: var_tailscale
app_vars.label: Join Tailscale Tailnet
app_vars.help: Adds HTTPS addresses on your tailnet; without an auth key the install prints a login URL

app_vars.name: var_ts_authkey
app_vars.label: Tailscale Auth Key
app_vars.help: Optional; joins the tailnet without the login URL

notes.text: The viewer (port 6080, user neo) password and the MCP token for port 9010 are in /opt/browseros-neo_data/.env. Send the token as an Authorization: Bearer header.
Open the viewer once and sign in to the sites your agents should use; logins persist across updates.
Anyone with the MCP token or viewer password controls a browser signed in to your accounts, over plain HTTP. Keep it on a trusted network or behind HTTPS.
